knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Objective
Parse feature summaries from script lymphocyte_distribution_summaries to neat 
ai_derived_features tables (unscaled and scaled versions)

```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse) 

to_box <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/"

feature_summary_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/lymphocyte_distribution_features/feature_summaries/")

parse_ai_features_dir <- paste0(to_box, "judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/parse_ai_features/")

parse_feature_summaries_new <- function(feature_summary) {
  
  feature_summary <- feature_summary %>%
    mutate(image_fragment_mucosa_name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, sep = "_"))
  
  #Log transform epi-lp ratio and select features
  ai_raw <- feature_summary %>%
  mutate(villi_lamina_propria_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio = log10(villi_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio + 1),
         crypts_lamina_propria_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio = log10(crypts_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio + 1)) %>%
  select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, image_fragment_mucosa_name,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2,
         villi_lamina_propria_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio,
         crypts_lamina_propria_epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_sd_log_closest_neighbor_um,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_median_log_closest_junction_um,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_median_log_closest_junction_um,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_median_log_closest_junction_um,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_median_log_closest_junction_um,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
         villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
         crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
         villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_mean_measured_area_um2,
         crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_sd_measured_area_um2,
         ) 
  
  #Pivot longer and rename
    ai_features_unscaled <- ai_raw %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = matches("^(villi|crypts)_"),
        names_to = c("layer", "compartment", "feature"),
        names_pattern = "^(villi|crypts)_(epithelium|lamina_propria)_(.*)$",
        values_to = "value") %>%
      mutate(feature = str_remove(feature, "^lymphocytes_")) %>%
      mutate(feature = str_remove(feature, "^lymphocyte_")) %>%
      mutate(layer = case_when(layer == "villi" ~ "Villi",
                               layer == "crypts" ~ "Crypts",
                               TRUE ~ layer),
             compartment = case_when(compartment == "epithelium" ~ "Epithelium",
                                     compartment == "lamina_propria" ~ "Lamina propria",
                                     TRUE ~ compartment),
             feature = case_when(
               feature == "epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio" ~ "Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio",
               feature == "count_per_1000_um2" ~ "Count",
               feature == "pct_cluster_ge_3" ~ "% in clusters",
               feature == "mean_log_closest_neighbor_um" ~ "Lymphocyte distance (mean)",
               feature == "sd_log_closest_neighbor_um" ~ "Lymphocyte distance (sd)",
               feature == "median_log_closest_junction_um" ~ "Junctional distance (median)",
               feature == "mean_measured_area_um2" ~ "Size (mean)",
               feature == "sd_measured_area_um2" ~ "Size (sd)",
               TRUE ~ feature))
    
    ai_features_scaled <- ai_raw %>%
        mutate(across(
          where(is.numeric),
          ~ (.x - median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)) / IQR(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
        )) %>%
        pivot_longer(
          cols = matches("^(villi|crypts)_"),
          names_to = c("layer", "compartment", "feature"),
          names_pattern = "^(villi|crypts)_(epithelium|lamina_propria)_(.*)$",
          values_to = "scaled") %>%
        mutate(feature = str_remove(feature, "^lymphocytes_")) %>%
        mutate(feature = str_remove(feature, "^lymphocyte_")) %>%
        mutate(layer = case_when(layer == "villi" ~ "Villi",
                                 layer == "crypts" ~ "Crypts",
                                 TRUE ~ layer),
               compartment = case_when(compartment == "epithelium" ~ "Epithelium",
                                       compartment == "lamina_propria" ~ "Lamina propria",
                                       TRUE ~ compartment),
               feature = case_when(
                 feature == "epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio" ~ "Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio",
                 feature == "count_per_1000_um2" ~ "Count",
                 feature == "mean_log_closest_neighbor_um" ~ "Lymphocyte distance (mean)",
                 feature == "sd_log_closest_neighbor_um" ~ "Lymphocyte distance (sd)",
                 feature == "median_log_closest_junction_um" ~ "Junctional distance (median)",
                 feature == "mean_measured_area_um2" ~ "Size (mean)",
                 feature == "sd_measured_area_um2" ~ "Size (sd)",
                 TRUE ~ feature))
      
    
    return(list(
    unscaled = ai_features_unscaled,
    scaled = ai_features_scaled
  ))
}

parse_feature_summaries<- function(feature_summary) {
  
  feature_summary <- feature_summary %>%
    mutate(image_fragment_mucosa_name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, sep = "_"))

      mutate(feature = str_remove(feature, "^lymphocytes_")) %>%
      mutate(feature = str_remove(feature, "^lymphocyte_")) %>%
      mutate(layer = case_when(layer == "villi" ~ "Villi",
                               layer == "crypts" ~ "Crypts",
                               TRUE ~ layer),
             compartment = case_when(compartment == "epithelium" ~ "Epithelium",
                                     compartment == "lamina_propria" ~ "Lamina propria",
                                     TRUE ~ compartment),
             feature = case_when(
               feature == "epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio" ~ "Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio",
               feature == "count_per_1000_um2" ~ "Count",
               feature == "pct_cluster_ge_3" ~ "% in clusters",

```

### Parse batch 0 (grading sample)
```{r}
subset_name <- "grading_sample"

feature_summaries <- fromJSON(paste0(feature_summary_dir, "lymphocyte_feature_summaries_", subset_name, ".json")) 
                          
parsed_features <- parse_feature_summaries(feature_summaries)

write_json(parsed_features$unscaled, paste0(parse_ai_features_dir, "unscaled_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty =TRUE)

write_json(parsed_features$scaled, paste0(parse_ai_features_dir, "scaled_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty =TRUE)
```

### Pull Batch 0 - new truncated
Just to extract the global size feature for path vs ai comparisom
```{r}
subset_name <- "batch_0"

subset <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_batch_0.json")

feature_summaries <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/lymphocyte_distribution_features/v2/feature_summaries/lymphocyte_feature_summaries_all_1_2830.json") %>%
  filter(image_name %in% subset$image_name) 

write_json(feature_summaries, paste0(parse_ai_features_dir, "feature_summaries_unprocessed_grading_sample.json"))

```

### Parse batch 1
```{r}
subset_name <- "batch_1"

feature_summaries <- fromJSON(paste0(feature_summary_dir, "lymphocyte_feature_summaries_", subset_name, ".json")) 
                          
parsed_features <- parse_feature_summaries(feature_summaries)

write_json(parsed_features$unscaled, paste0(parse_ai_features_dir, "unscaled_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty =TRUE)

write_json(parsed_features$scaled, paste0(parse_ai_features_dir, "scaled_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty =TRUE)
```


### Parse batch 2-6
```{r}
subset_name <- "full"

feature_summaries <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/lymphocyte_distribution_features/v2/feature_summaries/lymphocyte_feature_summaries_all.json") 

parsed_features <- parse_feature_summaries_new(feature_summaries)
unscaled <- parsed_features$unscaled
scaled <- parsed_features$scaled

write_json(parsed_features$unscaled, paste0(parse_ai_features_dir, "unscaled_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty =TRUE)

write_json(parsed_features$scaled, paste0(parse_ai_features_dir, "scaled_", subset_name, ".json"), pretty =TRUE)

```
